verdict.rationale: Exa ships its own agentic capabilities that accept delegated tasks. Exa Agent runs deep research, list building and enrichment with iterative search and grounded synthesis. Websets takes a natural-language query and then searches, verifies and enriches results autonomously, and it can be used from a no-code Dashboard. However, these are task-specific research agents, mostly API-driven, rather than a general built-in assistant. Hands-on users also report delegated Websets runs stalling on 'Verifying' and failing to populate requested enrichment columns. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product conversational assistant, evidence that Exa Agent is usable inside the UI rather than only via API, and reliable hands-on completion of delegated tasks.
